revenue.source: VINCI FY2024 annual results press release (2023, 2024 revenue excl. concession subsidiaries' works revenue); FY2025 full-year results press release 5-6 Feb 2026

operating_income.source: Operating income from ordinary activities (Ebit): FY2024 results release (2023, 2024); FY2025 consolidated income statement (9,558)

d_and_a.source: Depreciation and amortisation line, consolidated cash flow statements (2024 and 2025 annual financial statements on vinci.com)

capex.source: Purchases of PP&E and intangible assets, consolidated cash flow statements (2023, 2024, 2025). Excludes concession-related investments in operating financial assets.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 4.2% (2.6% organic); management guides to further growth in 2026; fade toward long-run nominal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 Ebit margin 12.8% (9,558/74,599), up from 12.6% in FY2024; hold roughly flat with a slight uplift from mix.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: French statutory corporate tax rate of ~25.8%.

wacc.source: Assumption: infrastructure/concessions-heavy European large cap; rf ~3.3%, ERP ~5%, beta ~0.8, leveraged capital structure. Not from a data provider.

net_debt.source: VINCI net financial debt at 31 Dec 2025 (19,075), FY2025 consolidated financial statements; excludes lease liabilities.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 567,060,313 (EPS note, FY2025 consolidated financial statements), in millions
